# GAME NOTE

> Player-made game walkthroughs, maps, boss references and editorial notes, published in Chinese and English. 攻略、地图、能力与成就资料，以及攻略整理手记。

GAME NOTE is an independent guide project, not an official game publisher.
The Well Dweller guide is in progress. A listed region is not necessarily a finished walkthrough.
Chinese pages use the main paths; corresponding English pages use /en/.
Follow the language links on each page to read the matching translation.

## Guide Archive

- [GAME NOTE](https://gamenote.cc/): Chinese homepage with the game archive, recent guide updates and original editorial notes.
- [English Homepage](https://gamenote.cc/en/): English entry point with corresponding guide, update and editorial-note links.
- [Game Archive](https://gamenote.cc/games/): Directory of Islets, ENDER LILIES and the ongoing Well Dweller guide project.
- [Islets Guide](https://islets.gamenote.cc/): Separate existing guide site for Islets, covering exploration, abilities, bosses and collectible reference material.
- [ENDER LILIES Guide](https://ender-lilies.gamenote.cc/): Separate existing guide site for ENDER LILIES; it has not been migrated into the main directory.

## Well Dweller / 黯井微光

- [Game Introduction](https://gamenote.cc/games/an-jing-wei-guang/): Game information, Steam store reference and entry points to the ongoing guide sections.
- [Walkthrough Index](https://gamenote.cc/games/an-jing-wei-guang/walkthrough/): Area-based illustrated walkthrough directory; available chapters contain practical route instructions and credited screenshots.
- [The Bog](https://gamenote.cc/games/an-jing-wei-guang/walkthrough/the-bog/): Entrance shafts, Ilda conversations, trinket-slot pickups, climbing practice and return visits near the tent.
- [Map Index](https://gamenote.cc/games/an-jing-wei-guang/maps/): Partial map references and regional landmark identification, separate from step-by-step walkthrough instructions.
- [World Structure Diagram](https://gamenote.cc/games/an-jing-wei-guang/maps/world/): Original editorial diagram of region entries; placement is not geographical and arrows represent reviewed route sequence, not surveyed corridors.
- [Ability Reference](https://gamenote.cc/games/an-jing-wei-guang/abilities/): Movement/core abilities and progression/utility unlocks, with effects, acquisition references and unresolved location details distinguished.
- [System Explanations](https://gamenote.cc/games/an-jing-wei-guang/systems/): Save tents, oil supplies, trinket upgrades, map reading and shops, kept separate from ability descriptions.
- [Achievements](https://gamenote.cc/games/an-jing-wei-guang/achievements/): All 41 Steam achievement names and descriptions in Chinese, paired with official English text on the English version.

## Optional

- [Editorial Notes](https://gamenote.cc/notes/): Original notes about organising routes, maps and practical guide information, rather than additional walkthrough chapters.
- [Update History](https://gamenote.cc/updates/): Dated guide and site updates with individual detail pages and related content links.
- [About GAME NOTE](https://gamenote.cc/about/): Guide-editor responsibilities, research methods, original-video credits and correction procedures.
- [Contact and Corrections](https://gamenote.cc/contact.html): Feedback instructions and repository links for guide corrections and content suggestions.

## Source and Coverage Notes

Well Dweller screenshots and video-derived routes credit the original creator, 好吃的香草雪球.
The guide editors organise the website text and bilingual presentation; they are not credited as the original video creator.
Source lists appear beneath relevant articles. Creator-profile links are labelled as profiles, not exact video links.
Steam achievement wording is distinct from an independently documented unlock route.
Draft boss pages and incomplete regions should not be treated as complete tactical guides.
Map screenshots can show partial exploration; do not infer full collectible totals from them.
Unverified room geometry, collectible coordinates and precise combat statistics are not invented.
This file is a navigation aid, not a replacement for robots.txt or a guarantee of search indexing.

## Maintenance

Updated: 2026-09-27.
Review this file when guide coverage or canonical paths change.
For corrections, include the page address, game region, specific issue and supporting material.
